fact_audit.claim: function useEffect(effect: () => (void | (() => void)), deps?: ReadonlyArray<any>): void
effect can optionally return a cleanup function, invoked before re-run and on unmount
deps compared via Object.is against previous value
omitted -> effect runs after every render
[] -> effect runs once after initial render, cleanup once on unmount
[a, b, ...] -> effect re-runs only when a listed value changes
